parallels.note: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”

people.name: Herod
people.line: Tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.
translations.bsb: “I beheaded John,” Herod said, “but who is this man I hear such things about?” And he kept trying to see Jesus.
translations.kjv: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
translations.asv: And Herod said, John I beheaded: but who is this, about whom I hear such things? And he sought to see him.
